t: Review and improve all 65 active lugs for naming quality, detail, and PEV compliance via dogfooded improve process
description: Every active lug (61 open + 4 in_progress) must meet quality standards: meaningful name (id=filename=intent), adequate description, PEV fields where required, self-contained for cold readers. Each lug runs through the improve process, dogfooded on a fresh sub-agent to verify clarity. Multi-session work, batched by type.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Epic tracking the quality review of all active lugs across multiple sessions
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not a one-shot cleanup — this is batched, methodical quality improvement

perceive: Scan WAI-Spoke/lugs/bytype/*/open/*.json and lugs/bytype/*/in_progress/*.json. For each lug: check id is meaningful, title is 5+ words and descriptive, PEV fields present for task/feature/bug/implementation types, description is adequate for cold read. Use the lug-reviewer subagent for batch validation.
execute: Process lugs in batches: (1) epics — 7 remaining open, (2) features — in_progress, (3) tasks — 0 open now, (4) other/ideas — 9 open. For each failing lug: apply wai-improve process, update file in place. Use dogfood sub-agent to verify each improved lug is cold-readable. Mark epic complete when all batches pass.
verify: grep -r "" WAI-Spoke/lugs/bytype/*/open/ | python3 tools/validate_lugs.py — all lugs pass PEV check. Run lug-reviewer on 3 random lugs cold — each can produce a concrete action plan.

Changes verified against project principles and mission goals
blocker_cleared_note: task-lug-folder-cleanup-and-hub-lugs completed — lug folder structure is clean
next_step: Batch 1: review and improve the 6 remaining open epics (doing this now as step 5). Batch 2: features in_progress.
